name: FractalCore
description: The central nervous system and backend orchestrator for Fractal. It handles multi-tenant task scheduling, real-time TFLOPs budgeting, and federated weight aggregation using FedAvg.

latest_release.name: FractalCore v1.0.0
latest_release.body: Initial institutional v1.0.0 release by Fractal Compute Orchestrations. Includes installable fractal_quant Python SDK and fractal CLI (FRQ4/FRQD block-wise INT4 codec, INT8 activation framing, error-feedback residual tracking, FedAvg/Median/Krum/FedProx aggregators), hardened coordinator server endpoints, slicer validation pipeline, CI matrix (Python 3.10 and 3.12), and built Python distribution artifacts under FRACTAL Proprietary Source-Available & Non-Commercial Restrictive License v3.1.
